        CLI_JSON_ENABLE = True

        CLI_JSON_VALIDATE_PATH = False", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(

        CLI_JSON_VALIDATE_PATH=False,
    )", "explanation": "Replace the deprecated v1 nested `class Config` with a `model_config` dict built via ConfigDict, keeping the same keys and values (migration.md#changes-to-config: 'set a class attribute called `model_config`... The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called `Config`... is now deprecated')."}], "notes": "The deprecated nested `class Config` on Options is replaced with `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` using the same three CLI_JSON_* keys and values. Caveats to verify outside this file: (1) the old form inherited from `DefaultConfig`, so any defaults that DefaultConfig defines beyond these three keys are no longer inherited here; I could not see DefaultConfig's contents, so please confirm it has no other needed defaults. (2) The CLI_JSON_* keys are custom, not pydantic ConfigDict keys. Pydantic v2 accepts unknown model_config keys at runtime, but pydantic_cli/core.py must read them from `model_config` (e.g. `model.model_config.get(...)`) rather than from a `Config` class attribute. That file is migrated separately and was not checked here. The `DefaultConfig` import was removed because nothing else in this file uses it."}
